title: PGA Tour 97
overview:
A Bold New Approach to Golf

The No.1 32-bit golf game debuts on Sega Saturn with a new look and a new attitude.

EA Sports proudly presents the only golf simulation licensed by the PGA TOUR; the only place you can compete with a field of real TOUR golfers on real TOUR courses.

- Fourteen featured PGA TOUR pros - 58 in all!
- Two incredible championship golf courses.
- Unrivaled gameplay, graphics, sound effects and music.
- Unique risk/reward feature factors degree of difficulty into every shot.

Play a round or a tourney, a shoot-out or Skins. But play to win because this isn't just golf.

This is the PGA TOUR.
